The machines that run sandboxes: join tokens, labels, drain and revoke. Super-admins only.

## List base images

`GET /v1/admin/hosts/images` (SDK method `listBaseImages`)

Kantel's base images as the index its build publishes them: each image's latest version on the `stable` channel, its newest versions and what their CVE scans found, and the templates built on them. An index that can't be read is answered as `error`, with no images. A deployment super-admin only (a key needs `hosts:admin`). Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned image patching on (`KANTEL_IMAGE_PATCHING`).

**Answers**

- `200`: [BaseImageList](/api/reference/types/#baseimagelist) (`application/json`). The base images.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## List hosts

`GET /v1/admin/hosts` (SDK method `listHosts`)

Every host that has joined, revoked ones included. A deployment super-admin only (a key needs `hosts:admin`).

**Answers**

- `200`: [HostList](/api/reference/types/#hostlist) (`application/json`). The hosts.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Make a host join token

`POST /v1/admin/hosts/join-tokens` (SDK method `createHostJoinToken`)

A one-use token, shown once, and the one-line command that installs the host agent on a Linux machine and joins it with the token. A deployment super-admin only (a key needs `hosts:admin`).

**Header parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | A key of your choosing, unique per call, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key gets the first call's answer and does nothing again. While the first call is still working, a retry is `conflict` (`details.idempotencyKey` `in_progress`): retry it later. A first call that didn't finish (it failed part way, or stopped answering) is never done again under its key: a retry is `conflict` (`held`), so check, then use a new key. The same key with a different request is `refused`. (at most 255 characters) |

**Body**: [CreateHostJoinTokenBody](/api/reference/types/#createhostjointokenbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [HostJoinToken](/api/reference/types/#hostjointoken) (`application/json`). The token and its command.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `409` conflict, `422` refused. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Revoke a host

`DELETE /v1/admin/hosts/{hostId}` (SDK method `revokeHost`)

Revokes its credential and closes its connection. Its sandboxes keep their disks but can't be reached until it joins again. `unavailable`, and not revoked, when its credential is kept by a part of the deployment that is off (an account's own host, with account hosts switched off). A deployment super-admin only (a key needs `hosts:admin`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostId` | string | yes | The host's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Host](/api/reference/types/#host) (`application/json`). The host, revoked.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get a host's usage

`GET /v1/admin/hosts/{hostId}/usage` (SDK method `getHostUsage`)

Its CPU, memory and disk as it reported them, every 5 seconds over the last hour. Poll with `since` set to the last point's `at` for only the newer points. A deployment super-admin only (a key needs `hosts:admin`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostId` | string | yes | The host's ID. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `since` | integer | no | Only the points after this time (epoch milliseconds). |

**Answers**

- `200`: [HostUsage](/api/reference/types/#hostusage) (`application/json`). The host's readings.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Update a host's agent

`POST /v1/admin/hosts/{hostId}/update` (SDK method `updateHostAgent`)

Asks the host to update its host agent to `latestVersion`, which it does when `updateAvailable` says so: it fetches that release's `kantel-host`, checks it against the release's `SHA256SUMS` and restarts into it. Its sandboxes keep running, but connections to them through Kantel (SSH, terminals, ports) drop for the few seconds it takes to connect again. Answers once the host has the new binary, with `updating` set until it connects on it. `conflict` when it's revoked or already up to date, `unavailable` when it isn't connected or the latest release can't be read, and `not_supported` when the host refuses. A deployment super-admin only (a key needs `hosts:admin`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostId` | string | yes | The host's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Host](/api/reference/types/#host) (`application/json`). The host, updating.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `501` not_supported, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Check for host updates

`POST /v1/admin/hosts/check-for-updates` (SDK method `checkHostUpdates`)

Reads Kantel's latest kantel-host release again now, rather than within the hour, so hosts behind a release just published show `updateAvailable` at once. It reads the release itself and names no version. At most one check every 30 seconds: within that, `checked` is false and nothing more is read. `not_supported` when the deployment sets the version hosts run (`KANTEL_HOST_VERSION`) or reads no release, `unavailable` when the release can't be read. A deployment super-admin only (a key needs `hosts:admin`).

**Answers**

- `200`: [HostReleaseCheck](/api/reference/types/#hostreleasecheck) (`application/json`). What the check found.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `501` not_supported, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get the public URL

`GET /v1/admin/public-url` (SDK method `getPublicUrl`)

Where hosts reach this control plane: the address join commands give them, and whether only a host on the same machine could use it. A deployment super-admin only (a key needs `hosts:admin`).

**Answers**

- `200`: [PublicUrl](/api/reference/types/#publicurl) (`application/json`). The public URL.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Set the public URL

`PUT /v1/admin/public-url` (SDK method `setPublicUrl`)

Sets where hosts reach this control plane, for the join commands made from now on, ahead of the deployment's own `KANTEL_PUBLIC_URL`. `null` goes back to the deployment's own. Hosts that have joined keep the address they joined with. A deployment super-admin only (a key needs `hosts:admin`).

**Body**: [SetPublicUrlBody](/api/reference/types/#setpublicurlbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [PublicUrl](/api/reference/types/#publicurl) (`application/json`). The public URL.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Make a pool of shared hosts

`POST /v1/admin/pools` (SDK method `createPool`)

An empty pool, for join tokens and moves to put shared hosts in. `conflict` when the name is taken. A host is moved between pools with `pool` on a host's change, once it is drained and has no sandboxes. A deployment super-admin only (a key needs `hosts:admin`).

**Header parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | A key of your choosing, unique per call, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key gets the first call's answer and does nothing again. While the first call is still working, a retry is `conflict` (`details.idempotencyKey` `in_progress`): retry it later. A first call that didn't finish (it failed part way, or stopped answering) is never done again under its key: a retry is `conflict` (`held`), so check, then use a new key. The same key with a different request is `refused`. (at most 255 characters) |

**Body**: [CreatePoolBody](/api/reference/types/#createpoolbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [Pool](/api/reference/types/#pool) (`application/json`). The pool.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `409` conflict, `422` refused. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
